body_markdown:
# Rocketable is hiring a Founding Engineer


### This role is unlike any engineering position you've seen.


[Alan Wells](https://substack.com/@rocketable)


Nov 22, 2025


I’m hiring a


[Founding Engineer](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/rocketable/c05dcac6-6b8f-451c-a628-de6070eeec45) to join my team at Rocketable.


Not to build another SaaS product. To build the platform that runs entire software companies autonomously.


The job: architect the nervous system for AI-run SaaS businesses. Multi-agent orchestration. Self-improving systems. Full-stack automation from customer support to production deployments.


The goal is to prove that AI can operate businesses at superhuman performance levels.


I’m looking for someone who has:


-


5+ years scaling distributed systems (100K+ daily active users)


-


Production experience integrating LLMs via foundation model APIs


-


Deep expertise in Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud infrastructure


-


Full-stack development fluency across the entire stack


-


The conviction that full software company automation is inevitable


We’re


[backed by $6.5M](https://rocketable.substack.com/p/the-takeoff-has-started) from Y Combinator, True Ventures, Bloomberg Beta, and Indie.vc, and others.


This person will be our first engineering hire, working onsite 5 days/week in San Francisco or Marin County, California.


Sound like you or someone you know?


**[Read more and apply here.](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/rocketable/c05dcac6-6b8f-451c-a628-de6070eeec45)**
